messages:
elaine (CEO): Quick heads-up: short all-hands next Wed 11:00 AM PT (30m). Agenda: company updates, Dedicated 'Pulse' launch highlights, short incident recap, hiring + policy notes, live Q&A. Recording will be posted. Drop Qs below.

harry (Product): I'm slotting a 6m demo for Dedicated 'Pulse' (v1.2). Need one line on migration assistance for existing customers  @toby can you draft?

toby (Comms): Yep. I'll write a 2-sentence customer note + internal blurb and paste here tomorrow.

mina (Eng): I'll cover the incident from Mar 8 (brief). Root cause: autoscaler config drift + a missed canary. Will summarize mitigation: stricter config linting + a safety kill-switch. Planning a 90s GIF showing timeline.

jess (People Ops): Hiring update: 10 new reqs opened, 4 offers acceptances. Also will announce referral bonus increase (details ready). Need 30s in the people block.

ops-bot: Reminder: add slide requests by EOD Tue. Use /allhands-slides to upload. Meeting link will be in calendar invite; recording posted to #all-hands-recordings after.

elaine (CEO): Quick Q prompt: what's the one thing your customers or team need clarity on? I'll start: "Will existing Dedicated customers on committed plans get the Pulse features without immediate pricing changes?" and "Any changes to data-retention defaults for hosted customers?"

harry (Product): From Product: will audits for model pinning be available in the Console? Also: will Optimize suggestions be opt-in?

mina (Eng): Ops want: include p50/p95 for the demo region and a quick note on expected steady-state throughput. I'll upload numbers.

toby (Comms): Draft customer sentence: "Existing Dedicated customers on active commitments will receive Pulse features during a phased rollout; your account team will contact you about any billing changes." Feedback?

jess (People Ops): For data-retention: legal confirmed we can extend default from 30d -> 60d for hosted but enterprise customers can request longer retention via contract amendment. I'll coordinate wording with @toby.

elaine (CEO): Post-meeting distribution plan: slides + recording + 3-sentence summary + 6 bullet takeaways posted to #all-hands-summary within 24 hours. Proposed takeaways: 1) Pulse (Dedicated v1.2) launch timeline and migration assistance, 2) Hosted retention default change (30->60d) and enterprise opt-ins, 3) Incident learnings: config linting + kill-switch, 4) Hiring push + referral bonus increase, 5) Console audits roadmap, 6) EU private-control-plane pilot timing. Assign owners in follow-up doc.

harry (Product): Noted. I'll provide the migration assistance bullet and migration playbook link before slides lock.

mina (Eng): I'll attach the incident artifact and the GIF. If someone can record the rollback demo for me (I have a late call), please ping.

jess (People Ops): Referral bonus text: "Referral bonus increased to $6k for senior ICs and $3k for junior roles for hires completed by Oct 31." Can we reserve 30s to mention that?

toby (Comms): Slides uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PulseSlidesDraft  please review and add comments. React with :eyes: when reviewed so we know status.

ops-bot: Slides received. Auto-reminder set for slide reviews at 9am Wed.

elaine (CEO): Cool. If you can't join live, post Qs here and we'll cover them in the 10m Q&A. Recording + slide deck + short action tracker will be published. Thanks team.

toby (Comms): Posted draft customer FAQ: https://redwood.in/pulse-faq-draft  comments appreciated.

mina (Eng): Uploaded incident timeline and p99 numbers. Minor correction on slide 4 (latency chart)  updated.

jess (People Ops): LGTM on slides.

ops-bot: Meeting calendar invite updated with Zoom link. Recording will appear here: https://redwood.zoom/rec/pulse123 (placeholder).

elaine (CEO): Final note: we'll publish owners + deadlines in the follow-up doc after the meeting. Please react :thumbsup: once your section is final. Thanks!
